name: Run Strides
instructions: Warm up with an easy jog.
Accelerate smoothly over about 20 seconds up to a fast but relaxed pace.
Hold a tall posture and relaxed face.
Walk back to recover, then repeat several times.
longevityNotes: Cardiovascular fitness is the single strongest predictor of a long, active life. Regular cardio work keeps the heart, lungs, and brain in shape for decades.
overview: Short controlled accelerations at about 80 to 90 percent of top speed that improve running mechanics.

safetyNotes: Warm up first; skip with hamstring or calf tightness.
